name: Suitcase
summary: Rolling hard-shell suitcase on two wheels with an extended handle; for travel scenes. anim roll rolls it.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the wheels rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the suitcase is about 450 px tall without the handle; use about 0.5–0.7 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: roll = wheels turn and the case sways along; the others are gentle motions

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (handle on the left when true)

author: krakujs
